errors.text_span: 在因子=13至49的区间内，特征值稳定在0.1至0.2之间，最终在因子=49处收敛至0
errors.evidence: Description states the plateau range is 0.1 to 0.2 and converges to 0 at factor 49, but the figure shows values between 0 and 1, not converging to 0.
The description does not explicitly mention the line is black and solid, only that it is marked by black circles.
The description mentions the x-axis and y-axis ranges and labels but omits that the y-axis range is from 0 to 10 with intervals of 2, as specified in the atom.
The description incorrectly states the x-axis tick interval is 2, but the figure and atom specify the x-axis range is 1 to 49 with an interval of 1.
The description adds an assumption about units not being labeled, which is not mentioned in the atoms or visible in the figure.
